name: Night Of The Forget Me Nots
author: Jewel Box
description: Makoto is on her way to the drama club’s spring retreat when she gets lost in the woods, so she’s pretty glad to meet up with another lost kid. Taking him under her wing, she heads for the old school where the retreat is going to take place, blissfully unaware of what lies in wait... [From Eien Ni Hen ]
